milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward the oxeye daisy cluster and face it, demonstrating visual identification. Target (4,0,3) is the centroid of 6 daisies placed at X=3-6, Z=1-4. Max distance of 5 ensures meaningful navigation from spawn (~5 blocks away). Facing tolerance of 60° confirms the player is looking at the flowers.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must continue past the daisy meadow and approach the birch fence gate, facing it to demonstrate visual identification. Target (8,0,5) matches the exact gate placement. Max distance reduced to 4 (from 5) to prevent triggering from the daisy cluster position (~4.5 blocks away), ensuring the player must physically advance past the daisies. Facing tolerance of 60° confirms the player is looking at the gate.
